rounds: Routine held two weeks running — that's actually something, even if it felt like going through the motions. But the Apollo ring moment? Someone opened a door and you shut it. A naked man on your finger started a conversation and you killed it.
pattern: They're fine with the costume, terrified of the explanation.
focus: Next time someone notices something gay on your body — ring, nail, whatever — let the conversation run for one more sentence than feels comfortable.
